entities.summary: Burail Fort is a fort situated in Sector 45 of Chandigarh, India (presently).It Is firstly Constructed by Raghuvanshi Rajputs in 12th Century. It was built during the Mughal period. It remained under the control of the Mughal Faujdar up till 1712 CE.
